recognize_zh: 低倍下抹片中充滿大小相近、核圓至略凹、染色質細緻、細胞質中等量灰藍色的大型芽細胞，部分成群聚集，成熟單核球與中性球極少，型態符合急性單核球性白血病的單核母細胞（monoblast）增生。
features: Numerous large blasts dominating the nucleated cells, occurring singly and in loose clusters
Round to slightly indented or folded nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli faintly visible
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, without obvious granules or Auer rods at this magnification
Occasional small lymphocytes and a rare neutrophil; few maturing myeloid cells
Low magnification limits evaluation of nucleoli, fine granules and cytoplasmic vacuoles
describe_en: Smear (likely peripheral blood) at low power shows a marked increase in large blasts, which constitute the majority of nucleated cells. The blasts are relatively uniform, with round to slightly folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of grey-blue agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen at this magnification. Maturing granulocytes are rare, with only occasional small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry, flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b) and KMT2A rearrangement studies confirm the subtype.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant cytoplasm and higher N:C ratio, and are MPO/NSE negative with TdT and B- or T-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm with occasional granules or Auer rods and lack monocytic markers such as CD14, CD64 and NSE positivity.
Microgranular APL shows bilobed or folded nuclei with fine granules, strong MPO, is HLA-DR/CD34 negative and carries PML::RARA.
Reactive monocytes are mature with condensed folded nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm, without sheets of blasts with fine chromatin.
